notes.title: Iwakura Aria is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Iwakura Aria is OUT NOW![/h2][p][/p][p]The year is 1966. It was the last Sunday in June, a blisteringly hot day and everything was about to change. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/3dfcf0d02b3fdf2a329605da150cdbf0554e29e5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Ichiko Kitagawa, a young orphan with a love for drawing, had just stepped foot into her future home, the grand Iwakura estate on the outskirts of Tokyo. Lifted from the streets and offered a new life as a maid, Ichiko enters a world that would alter the course of her life forever.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/1893b15b6a4e2932e170466212efc562a3ef43bc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Iwakura Aria invites you to explore the elegant yet unsettling rooms of the Iwakura mansion. The story unfolds within these walls, and the mansion is open for you to explore. Returning to familiar rooms may reveal new details or hidden truths waiting to be uncovered.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/ceac9cd3437a09f654459b60252944f3dde941c3.jpg"][/img]
At the center of this story is Aria Iwakura, the beautiful daughter of the household. Aria is cold and fragile, but she soon melts in the presence of Ichiko. Their relationship, delicate and slow-burning, evolves with each passing day. Despite their different roles within the mansion, the two share a quiet bond over art, both finding comfort in creativity and moments of peace. For Aria, who spends her days entertaining guests and living under the weight of the Iwakura name, Ichiko’s presence is something rare.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/8269f48dcafbf00bbe35f35d5696b3f5be018c8c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But not all is as it seems in the Iwakura mansion.[/p][p]As Ichiko’s bond with Aria deepens, she soon finds herself unraveling not just the secrets of the mansion, but the hidden lives of those within it. The truths she uncovers will change everything.[/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="ZhhaUrTpR-s;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Storytelling and Artwork
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/ccf919c17a03ac397cb0881ca196cc5e4f4c08d8.png"][/img][/p][p]Iwakura Aria has been praised in Japan for the rich quality of the artwork. Boasting a stunning painterly style, gorgeous character sprites and lavish backgrounds, Iwakura Aria’s art direction is certainly unique. It lends the whole story a certain seriousness which gives it a drama-like quality.[/p][p]Typical to other visual novels are the stunning game CGs. These crop up in some of the game’s more poignant moments as you’d expect, and are always nothing short of picturesque. However, Iwakura Aria also deploys other art styles at key moments which serve as a perfect compliment to the game's beautiful colour CGs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/76ecf4f4e79f9ee8088aac7faac817ccd471ef71.jpg"][/img][/p][p]At times throughout the story, there are important moments that need to be captured with more intimacy or sensitivity which a normal CG may not so easily convey.[/p][p]In Iwakura Aria, these moments are brought to life with a number of hand-drawn cut outs. Panels which focus on a particular detail or moment.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/f32a040cb421bf61b10b70db41eea9577d1195a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The brush of a hand, a touch of lipstick, a tender moment between Ichiko and Aria or in some cases a more sinister or unsettling scene.[/p][p]These cut-aways bring real focus to these moments and often-times help bring the viewer closer to a scene and amplify the emotion of it – helping to convey passing seconds of sadness, or fear, or tenderness.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/8ed78bb9b53f5494eeaf66fd2c9497c72b8af11f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While we always enjoy the reveal of a CG in any of our visual novels, here the cut-aways deliver a punch that a ‘normal’ CG may not often achieve – which gives Iwakura Aria an edge all of its own.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Character Profile - Iwakura Mansion
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/a594d9008450e504b681b935506d38ec3e6b396f.png"][/img][/p][p]While the ensemble cast in Iwakura Aria is undoubtedly one of the game’s strengths, special praise must also be given to the mansion itself.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/539f16c3374bb7767d0fac22b133f4a8cc760557.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With a small cast of characters Iwakura Aria can feel intimate as you come to know everyone in detail. [/p][p]Likewise, the story is largely confined to the mansion and its grounds, giving players the space to fully absorb and appreciate the world Mages have created. With this, over time you may feel very connected to the household itself.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/79fd676a33dce179f7f728a3b7d767cb801d8e94.jpg"][/img][/p][p]On arriving at the mansion, you are able to freely roam from room to room via the game’s mansion menu.[/p][p]Key rooms are highlighted for the purpose of progressing the story but of course much of your enjoyment of Iwakura Aria may come from discovering little bits of character and history as you snoop in every nook and cranny.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/16b2ecb8ee6bb088e1c11e092e1358eaa6677e1f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]By moving from room to room, you begin to appreciate how lavish and detailed the game's environments are. With Ichiko's love of art and architecture, she is quick to convey a lot of detail about each room as she goes in.[/p][p]By revisiting rooms you may even discover something new. All this helps add depth and significance to each space within the household. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/de699afcfbdd5669115f245f609dc89c74c6a9e8.jpg"][/img][/p][p] Only by fully exploring each room, through each phase of the story, can you unravel the secrets of the Iwakura family and those that reside within it.[/p][p][/p][p]We highly recommend you take your time through Iwakura Aria to explore every corner of this mansion.[/p][p]It’s a place that, by the story's end, will undoubtedly linger long in your memory.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Character Profile - Amane Iwakura
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/f9020f6e32de75db8f4202f7b05bcb3767aa032f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/a3fd450d649d06abb29dac704f6375d2020f5169.png"][/img][/p][p]Amane Iwakura is the head of the Iwakura household. He is warm and welcoming to Ichiko and fiercely protective of his daughter Aria.[/p][p]He is a wealthy and well-respected man. Despite his dedication to work and many social engagements, he always makes time and is there for his beloved daughter, Aria. He also takes an active interest in the running of the household to ensure everyone is welcome and comfortable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/3dfcf0d02b3fdf2a329605da150cdbf0554e29e5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]His kindness to Ichiko as the story begins is matched by the warmth of his welcome. While there is an undeniable power difference between him and Ichiko he rarely allows it to show. He is often notably generous, especially shown in his willingness to support Ichiko’s artistic aspirations.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/0e663a3627f82b97c70187d931b45c9e77f5496f.jpg"][/img]But all is not as it seems with Amane.[/p][p]Ichiko quickly senses that his relationship with Aria is… unusual to say the least. On exploration of the mansion, Ichiko learns that things are not quite right, with hidden secret upon hidden secret posing more and more questions about this seemingly respectable man...[/p]

notes.title: Character Profile - Sui Miyauchi
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/3b7fa001e4f845e53d258108744ef8e7c3a666ec.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/059b981f7aaf096bef38be3b69348b710bbe8459.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]On arriving at the Iwakura household, Ichiko finds herself isolated and alone. While Amane is warm and welcoming, he remains clearly in a position of authority over her. Aria, meanwhile, is initially distant and irritable.[/p][p]Thankfully, Sui is there as a light-hearted and jovial colleague. Ichiko soon forms a strong friendship with her.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/b3eb17ab16574613c378f9767f76dd71922c7e92.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The daughter from a family of cooks, Sui, works the kitchen in the Iwakura household. [/p][p]As a talented Chef, Sui is on hand to prepare meals for the family but most importantly provides the food for the Iwakura household’s many guests.[/p][p]
As people of high importance, Amane and Aria regularly host gatherings, sometimes multiple times a week and Sui is always there, working hard to provide the best food for such occasions.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/f00f36e4b55fed84a4b3c5537f37120a71ecd53c.png"][/img][/p][p]Her disposition is bright and breezy, always so quick to crack a joke and a smile to Ichiko. She listens without judgment as Ichiko tries to adjust to her new surroundings. While young in years, she is headstrong and dependable making her an ideal friend to help Ichiko settle in.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/14f435d8c9a729933e471655e0ca34883aa63bf4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]How will their friendship develop? What does she know about the secrets of the household? And is her fate, like Aria, tied to decisions in the story?[/p]

notes.title: Character Profile - Aria Iwakura
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/0db4b76d184f9ef2c2c0e0adc9ad990db52eb1ea.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/653ba30f26a2a122c60d8c7f4ffebd43f5955820.png"][/img][/p][p]Aria Iwakura - strikingly beautiful, enchanting and mysterious. She can be considered the story’s ‘main’ character, as so much of the story revolves around her and her fate.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/e91f0cbb0cf1d244e83601cbf15d21a5d136e8ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The daughter of the Iwakura household, Aria is a frail young woman, quick to exhaustion. Her father, Amane, worried about how isolated and lonely she is, carefully selects Ichiko as his house-keeper, with a view to her being good company for Aria and, potentially, a friend.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/a77c06a09ff41c1e0ad9e72a35d6c7242037953f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Aria, however, is cold and hostile. She comes across cautious and slow to warm to their new houseguest. But with a keen appreciation for art, she eventually warms to Ichiko’s passionate and curious nature, and they eventually form an incredibly strong bond.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/ac4013f35f90d7ff819eb8bc09a75010e4014509.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But Aria's true relationships with those around her, beg the greatest questions.[/p][p]Things are not how they seem with Aria and her father. Why does the gardener stare piercingly at her? How does she support her fathers business?[/p][p]How does she truly feel about Ichiko?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/12df2d62e91afd680fbd2a78c990c2fd99b37444.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Only by exploring the mansion and deepening her bond with Aria can Ichiko uncover the devastating truth, and bring about a promising fate for this extraordinary young woman.[/p]

notes.title: Character Profile - Ichiko Kitagawa
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/f5dc5454ce362f080484b3d669fe4cac6e32878d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/b7f458c12eb033ab44d78827ef59bcf4dc4626d9.png"][/img][/p][p]Iwakura Aria is explored through the eyes of Ichiko Kitagawa. [/p][p]At the beginning of the story, you step into the role of Ichiko Kitagawa. Though she is rarely seen, appearing only in sketches, cutscenes and CGs, the narrative is driven predominantly through her voice.[/p][p]You meet Ichiko in what is now modern-day Japan. It’s here that she begins to recount the tale of her time at the Iwakura household, where you have yet to learn her true fate. The choices you make in these past events will help guide the story.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/dd76886db96de0a076bcd48aa00cb488a2733510.png"][/img][/p][p]Ichiko is a young orphan girl. Having recently lost her job at a construction company, she returns to the orphanage where she grew up. It is here that she is fortunate enough to meet the enigmatic Amane Iwakura. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/b27312f22b48f5a9105e323d4606e37b47900802.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Mr Amane sees the talent Ichiko has and buys one of her art pieces in the street that he feels his daughter might like. This unexpected meeting with him ends with her being offered full time employment at the Iwakura household. An event which dramatically changes the course of her life.[/p][p]On arriving at the Iwakura mansion, she meets the initially hostile Aria.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/1893b15b6a4e2932e170466212efc562a3ef43bc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In time, Ichiko forms a strong relationship with Aria. In doing so, it sets off a chain of events which reveals the mansion’s true darkness.[/p][p]Only through Ichiko’s story and choices can you bring about one of 9 different fates for both Ichiko and Aria.[/p]

The Trial version features three areas of the story that you can explore: [/p][p]🏰 [b]The Iwakura Mansion[/b][/p][p][b]🫀 Her Body[/b][/p][p][b]👭 Aria and Ichiko[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Play through each part and get a feel for the atmosphere, characters, and the deeper story that awaits.[/p][p]Iwakura Aria is a moving visual novel that follows the deepening connection between Ichiko and Aria. notes.title: Iwakura Aria is Coming on 14th August 2025!
notes.notes:
[b]Iwakura Aria Launches on 14th August 2025![/b]

Prepare to step inside the halls of the Iwakura Mansion, where traces of the past remain and secrets await.

In Iwakura Aria, you’ll take on the role of Ichiko, a young maid with a passion for drawing that has just been given the opportunity of a lifetime, to live and work within the grand estate of the Iwakura family. What begins as a simple live-in job gradually draws you into the private world of the household and closer to its beautiful heir, Aria.

Playing as Ichiko, you’ll learn to navigate your new duties, capture choice moments through your sketches, and become entangled with Aria, the elegant and beautiful daughter that captures your attention. Spend time with her in quiet moments, observe how she carries herself behind closed doors, and uncover the truths hidden within the estate’s walls.

Forge relationships and tread carefully because not everything in Iwakura Mansion is as it seems. A deeper story lies beneath the surface, and every truth you find brings you closer to the heart of it.
Not long now until you can play this gripping suspense visual novel!

notes.title: Iwakura Aria coming soon!

[b]Iwakura Aria is Coming Soon![/b]

Are you ready for a gripping and suspenseful visual novel?

Set in post-war Japan, Ichiko is a young woman left and lost in the shadows of a broken society. With no hope for the future, she grasps a chance at a new beginning as the maid of the Iwakura Household.

A family shrouded in secrets.

As Ichiko, you’ll uncover a hidden world within the mansion’s walls. Prepare to journey through time, unravel chilling secrets, and discover a romance that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

[b]Coming THIS YEAR![/b]
